sql:
SELECT races.name AS first_race, results.points AS points
FROM drivers
JOIN results ON results.driverId = drivers.driverId
JOIN races ON races.raceId = results.raceId
WHERE drivers.forename = 'Lewis' AND drivers.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND races.year = (SELECT MIN(r.year) FROM races r JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = res.driverId WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton');
